title: 2026 F-gas leak-check frequency and automatic-detection QA

sources.title: Checking F gas equipment for leaks
Record F gas in equipment you own or service

facts.source_fact: Leak-check responsibilities cover specified stationary RACHP, fire-protection, refrigerated-truck/trailer, switchgear and organic Rankine equipment.
Leak-check frequency depends on F-gas amount and GWP expressed through CO2e thresholds.
Equipment from 5 to less than 50 tonnes CO2e requires checks at least every 12 months.
Equipment from 50 to less than 500 tonnes CO2e requires checks at least every 6 months.
Specified equipment at 500 tonnes CO2e or more has tighter leak-check requirements, with legacy switchgear/ORC conditions stated separately.
Automatic leak detection can double the allowed interval between leak checks where applicable.
Automatic leak detection is required at 500 tonnes CO2e or more except for the stated legacy switchgear/ORC exception.
If a leak is found it must be repaired as soon as possible and retested within one month.
Equipment at 5 tonnes CO2e or more within the record-keeping scope requires five-year records including gas quantities and leak-check results.
Leak-check compliance records indicate monitoring activity, not a directly measured parcel emissions inventory.
